Name: Brighter Mine Levels
Author: neeflower
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Brighter Mine Levels improves visibility throughout the Mines by reducing the dark ambient lighting used in vanilla. The difference is most noticeable on floors 30-39 of the Mines, but all levels are affected by default.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Lighting adjustments are available for every section of the Mines, as well as the Skull Cavern and the Ginger Island Volcano. Each area can be enabled or disabled separately, and the brightness level can be adjusted as well. The ambient fog option applies specifically to floors 30-39, as the effect is not used in the other mine sections.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]The mod works on its own with an editable config.json, but Generic Mod Config Menu support is included for easier in-game configuration.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size]
1. Download and install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] (version 4.5.2 at the time of upload)
2. Download and extract BrighterMineLevels into your Stardew Valley\Mods folder.
3. Launch Stardew Valley via SMAPI.
